facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/red-creek-campground ('Restrooms are not available at this site.' 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Small high-elevation USFS campground in the Dolly Sods area.  Almost always full on weekends and in nice weather.  Cash only, exact change.  --AWH
summary: Confirmed $11/site/night on the Forest Service page; booking set from the FS page and recreation.gov's information-only listing: not reservable, first-come (AWH), 14-day max (overrides nothing inherited but the agency row's reservable/platform hints). FS page says no restrooms and no potable water. Not stated: season (FS gives 'Operational Hours 24/7' only), site count, rig length. Potomac/Cheat-Potomac Ranger District; Forest Service-run, no concessioner named. Note trimmed of the FCFS and price restatements.
flags: Aggregator link in website: https://thedyrt.com/camping/west-virginia/west-virginia-red-creek should be removed (the FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/red-creek-campground is already there).
Missing phone: Cheat-Potomac Ranger District (304) 257-4488 (the FS page gives only the Supervisor's Office in Elkins).
Criteria (soft): the FS page calls it 'primitive, small' and posts no site lengths; nothing official says what rig fits (AWH has stayed).
FS page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site'; recorded as no flush or vault toilets. If AWH remembers a vault toilet, the FS page may be stale.

Road caveat (not a closure of the campground): Forest Road 19 closed from June 22, 2026 'from the west at the existing gate near Laneville, WV and extend to the intersection with FR75', timeline undetermined (alert runs to June 15, 2027). The FS directions (Jordan Run Rd / SR 4 from Hopeville to FR 19, then FR 75) use the open eastern end: 'Access to the Dolly Sods Wilderness is still available from FR19 via Jordan Run Rd near Hopeville'.
Forest Order 21-94 bans camping within 300 ft of FR 19/FR 75 in the Dolly Sods areas 'excluding the Red Creek Campground'; the campground itself is exempt.
